scripts.preinstall:
node -e "if(+process.versions.node.split('.')[0]<24){console.error('
  Crew Board needs Node 24 or newer, but this is '+process.version+'.
  Fix:  nvm install 24 && nvm use 24   (then:  npm ci)
');process.exit(1)}"
